g.text: Server takeover (scenario 1): no controller on level2 at all
subscribe building/level2/#; threshold rule on raw readings
PUT 37 level2 doors closed_unlocked (direct: nobody listens on commands/level2)
ALL CLEAR: lock on level0, level1 and level2 (direct for a floor still under takeover)
30 s without any level2 heartbeat (90 s grace after the server's own boot) → SERVER TAKEOVER of level2
first level2 heartbeat → SERVER HANDBACK, unsubscribe building/level2/#
